headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 16, 2026**
article:
The St. Louis Cardinals suffered a 3-0 shutout loss to the Chicago Cubs, while the Cincinnati Reds edged out the Miami Marlins 1-0. The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 4-8 victory over the Boston Red Sox, and the Chicago White Sox took down the Detroit Tigers in two separate games, winning 9-5 and 4-3.

Injuries and availability have impacted several teams, with Sebastián Rivero (Los Angeles Angels) and Vladimir Guerrero Jr. (Toronto Blue Jays) being placed on the 60-day and 7-day injured lists, respectively. Abner Uribe (Milwaukee Brewers) has been placed on the 15-day injured list, while Colt Emerson (Seattle Mariners) and Davis Martin (Chicago White Sox) have been placed on the 10-day and 15-day injured lists, respectively. Matt Chapman (San Francisco Giants) has been transferred to the 60-day injured list, and Trevor McDonald (San Francisco Giants) has been transferred to the 60-day injured list. Garrett Whitlock (Boston Red Sox) has been placed on the 15-day injured list.

Several trades and roster movements have taken place, including Jonathan Ornelas being traded from the Athletics to the Milwaukee Brewers for cash, and Harold Rivas being traded from the Boston Red Sox to the Baltimore Orioles. The Miami Marlins have traded Jacob Berry to the Kansas City Royals.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Fall to Cubs in 3-0 Shutout**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals suffered a 3-0 loss to the Chicago Cubs, with the Cubs' pitching staff shutting out the Cardinals.

top_news.title: **Reds Take Down Marlins in Close Contest**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds edged out the Miami Marlins 1-0, with Chase Burns pitching a strong 7.0 innings, striking out 8 and allowing 0 earned runs. Eugenio Suárez led the Reds' offense with a double and 1 RBI.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Red Sox 8-4**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 4-8 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Bubba Chandler earning the win after 5.0 IP, 5 K, 2 ER, 2 BB, 4 H. Rafael Flores Jr. led the Red Sox with 3 H, 1 HR, 2 RBI, and 4 AB.

top_news.title: **White Sox Take Down Tigers 9-5**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox secured a 9-5 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Miguel Vargas leading the charge at the plate. Vargas hit two home runs, including his 27th of the season, and drove in three runs.

top_news.title: **White Sox Edge Tigers in Thrilling 4-3 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox secured a narrow win over the Detroit Tigers, with a final score of 4-3. Randal Grichuk, Andrew Benintendi, Tristan Peters, and Eduardo Valencia were among the key contributors for the winning team.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Take Down Cubs 8-4**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals secured an 8-4 victory over the Chicago Cubs, with multiple players making significant contributions to the win. Alec Burleson, Joshua Báez, Blaze Jordan, Pedro Ramírez, and Michael Conforto were among the impact hitters, while Michael McGreevy stood out on the mound.

top_news.title: **Rivero Lands on 60-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Los Angeles Angels catcher Sebastián Rivero has been placed on the 60-day injured list due to a left hamate fracture. The injury occurred on August 15, 2026.

top_news.title: **Brewers Bolster Infield with Ornelas Acquisition**
top_news.summary: The Milwaukee Brewers have strengthened their roster with the addition of shortstop Jonathan Ornelas, acquired in a trade with the Athletics for cash.
